newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TNT considers transatlantic uplift options.
newsitem.headline: TNT considers transatlantic uplift options.

text.p: TNT is considering its options for transatlantic uplift as part of its move to Liege on March 1, a spokesman said.
TNT currently has a space allocation of some 20 tonnes in each direction on a Lufthansa Boeing 747 freighter to New York from Cologne.
However, when the integrator moves from its Cologne hub to Liege this may no longer be feasible, he said.
Airfreight is then sent via TNT aircraft from Cologne to various points in the UK and Ireland, including London Stansted, Birmingham, Belfast, Liverpool, Edinburgh and Dublin.
As well as this, the integrator used uplift on passenger aircraft from Cologne to the U.S., he added.
"Our current supplier will probably not be providing the service so we are pursuing alternatives, as well as looking into the possibility of using our own dedicated charter operations."
But he did not completely rule out the possibility of continuing to use Lufthansa after the move. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017 - www.racs.com
